d: In the final hours of the Texas Senate race, the Democratic candidate takes aim at billionaire mega-donors, super PACs and Elon Musk, accusing them of trying to buy the Senate seat. Addressing supporters in Austin during the “Clear Eyes, Full Hearts” tour, the candidate vows to defeat Republican Ken Paxton and deliver a historic upset. Framing the contest as a battle between ordinary Texans and powerful billionaires, the candidate highlights the contrast between their legislative record and Paxton’s criminal record.
